about: Plain decode per stream (tokens a second, the server's timings) at `concurrency` streams decoding 256 tokens each from short prompts, --spec none --no-prefix-reuse, master f68eca34 (2026-10-31, the Quadro GV100 among the cards; first measured at master 03afc418 on 2026-10-28, choice-notes/lab/speed_model). The facts: the GGUF tensor tables (unsloth/Qwen3.5-9B-MTP-GGUF, unsloth/gemma-4-12b-it-GGUF) and the plan's. Long contexts (rows marked long: one stream decoding 513 tokens after 7K, 41K and 82K-token prompts, mdecl.sh, 2026-10-31; context = the prompt + 256, the decode's mean) of the same three files on eight cards, the GV100 among them. Steps at 1, 2, 4 and 8 rows at a long context (mbatchl.sh, 2026-10-31: each row its own ~18K-token prompt and 6000 tokens; the windows whose mean batch is C pool the C-row phase with the ends of the later phases, so the context, the rows' mean prompt + 3000, holds within about 3000 tokens; row counts other than 1, 2, 4, 8 or with fewer than 4 windows left out).
